span.p:
Record FABRIC_MOVEMENT
type = receipt
colour, supplier, metres, cost

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Raw fabric inventory
e.g. Brown Fabric: 500 m

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Product-Fabric BOM
Product A -> Brown, 1.8 m/unit
Product B -> Brown, 2.4 m/unit
Product C -> Brown, 1.2 m/unit

div.style: color: rgb(71, 85, 105) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Many finished products consume the SAME
raw fabric. Deduction must be driven by a
bill of materials, not by a per-product
stock count - otherwise the shared pool
is double-counted.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Specify product + quantity
e.g. 100 x Product A

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Compute requirement from BOM
100 x 1.8 m = 180 m Brown

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Shortfall flagged
Block or part-release the order

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Raise purchase requirement
with lead time

type = consumption
deduct actual metres used

span.p:
Depletion forecast
remaining metres / consumption rate
= expected depletion date

div.style: color: rgb(71, 85, 105) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Forecast blends production plan with actual
sales velocity per product, so a fast-selling
SKU pulls its fabric's depletion date forward.
This is the proactive part of Req 7.2 -
avoiding production delays, not just
reporting stock after the fact.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Depletion date
inside supplier
lead time?
